verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://cloudconvert.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the CloudConvert API documentation. A second docs/llms.txt lists agent-readable summaries of the task types, from optimize, watermark and capture through archive, metadata, custom commands, the AI task, MCP, signed URLs and the Socket API. An agent can be pointed straight at structured, agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs end to end, and evidence of a fuller companion file (e.g. llms-full.txt) with complete content.
